text:
DeployBot: alert: embeddings p95 up ~28% vs baseline after v3.6.1 rollout. auto-revert score=0.7 :warning:
Alex H: saw it. which customers impacted?
DeployBot: impact: dedicated-pool-3 (3 tenants). hosted unaffected. error-rate stable. failing: embedding similarity regression on eval set.
Sara P: can we soft-unwind traffic for embeddings to stop exposure while we assess? Pining to v3.6.0 for the affected pool seems safest.
Mike L: dedicated customers have contracts; avoid autorollback without comms. manual action preferred.
Emma R: I can draft customer-facing note and release note update. keep wording short and non-technical.
Alex H: decision: manual rollback for dedicated-pool-3, suppress auto-revert. Hosted stays. Sara, can QA run a quick similarity smoke?
Sara P: yes — will run smoke on the designated canary tenant when rollback completes.
Mike L: runbook: 1) pin v3.6.0 to pool, 2) rollback pool to v3.6.0, 3) run embed similarity smoke, 4) notify customers. Who owns?
Alex H: I'll do pin+rollback. Emma owns communications. Sara owns QA.
DeployBot: suggested commands:
```
redwood release pin v3.6.0 --targets=dedicated-pool-3
redwood deploy rollback --to v3.6.0 --scope=dedicated-pool-3
```
OncallBot: note: change window open until 23:00 UTC. if rollback overlaps window boundary, notify customers and ops.
Alex H: running pin now. will follow with rollback in 2m.
Alex H: pin succeeded. starting rollback.
Alex H: rollback complete.
Sara P: smoke results: similarity back within ~1.2% of baseline on canary tenant, payloads look good.
Emma R: sending customer note and updating release notes. Draft: "We observed a regression in embedding similarity for a small set of dedicated tenants after the recent model update. We have reverted those tenants to v3.6.0. We will follow up with a full post-mortem and next steps."
Mike L: create postmortem ticket and tag legal if SLA impact possible.
Alex H: PM-4523 created and assigned to eng-ml + infra. https://pm.internal/4523
Sara P: follow-up action: retest v3.6.1-q (quantized candidate) in staging and run the embedding eval before any re-rollout.
DeployBot: log: manual rollback executed by Alex H; auto-revert suppressed per operator decision.
Emma R: thanks team, nice coordination. :clap:
Alex H: closing thread after postmortem links are posted.
